final.summary: One loosely similar prior decision about test fixtures was judged not exploitable. This issue has not been decided.

precedents.title: Hard-coded credential in the test fixtures
precedents.rationale: The credential was for a throwaway test container.
precedents.quote: Not exploitable: the credential belongs to a throwaway container used only by the unit tests.

caveats: The precedent concerns test fixtures and is only loosely similar.
